pages.title: The Botany Table
pages.text: The Botany Table is found in Overgrown Greenhouses, or purchased from a Botanist Villager. It can be used to combine two Pollen Vials and a Pigment Jar to breed a new flower.

pages.title: Flower Breeding
pages.text: The type of flower you get is determined by the Pollen, and its colour by the Pigment. Two Pollen Vials of the same type will produce that kind of flower, giving you the option to $(l:recolouring)recolour$(/l) that species. Two Vials of differing types can produce $(l:recipes)totally new flowers$(/l)!
